rationale.color_psychology: Deep Quantum Blue anchors the studio's long-horizon trust and discipline. Teal serves as the directional signal — clear, calm, technically precise. Energetic Orange ignites action without screaming. Mindful Gray scaffolds without distracting. Growth Light signals emergence without falling into wellness/consciousness framing.
rationale.competitor_differentiation: Explicitly avoids generic SaaS purple (forbidden). The palette is editorial-documentary, not corporate-bright or wellness-pastel. It's tuned for restraint and craft, not for conversion-optimization brightness.

primary.name: Deep Quantum Blue
primary.usage: Anchor backgrounds, long-horizon trust, dark metal emblem surface, triptych left panel, X/LinkedIn banners

secondary.name: Consciousness Teal
secondary.usage: Primary accent, directional signal, metallic 3D object color, triptych center/right panel, glass logo

accent.name: Energetic Orange
accent.usage: CTA, ignition, launch moments, wax seal, Instagram Story CTA

contrast_checks.use_case: Positive signals, emergence markers on dark

do: Use as anchor background for editorial contexts
Pair with white or Growth Light for high-contrast typography
Apply to dark metal emblem and triptych left panel
Use for hero backgrounds where long-horizon trust is needed
dont: Don't apply purple-tinted variations (#7C3AED is forbidden)
Don't pair with gradients that look SaaS-template
Don't use at low contrast against white (#3F51B5 fails AA)

do: Use as directional signal in editorial compositions
Apply to metallic 3D object surfaces and triptych center/right
Pair with Deep Quantum Blue for cool editorial contrast
Use for glass logo and accent surfaces
dont: Don't use at low opacity against white (contrast drops below AA)
Don't pair with stock wellness pastels (forbidden framing)
